clauses.text: We understand from your message that you received a rent-increase notice on 28 October, that it states an increase from CHF 1,720 to CHF 1,805 per month from 1 February, and that it gives the mortgage reference interest rate as the reason.

We cannot determine the applicable challenge deadline from the information currently available, because the years for the receipt date and effective date are not stated and no proof of receipt is provided.
Please send us a scan of the rent-increase notice, as you offered, and tell us the year you received it and the year the increase is due to take effect.
Please also send your lease contract and proof of when the notice was received.

To review the rent and calculation, please provide evidence of your current rent and its components, the previous rent adjustment, and the notice's stated reasons and calculation, including the reference-rate basis and relevant dates.
